title.zh: 修好七个音色被误设成高通滤波（发尖/发薄）
title.en: Seven patches were accidentally high-passed — thin and harsh

highlights.zh: 滤波类型参数里 1 = 高通（0 = 低通），但代码注释一直写「SVF」，于是七个音色一直被高通掉低频：实测 strings_lead 过零率是原生的 11 倍。
highlights.en: Filter type 1 is a HIGH-PASS (0 is the lowpass), but the comments called it "SVF" — so seven patches had their body filtered away, with strings_lead measuring eleven times the native's zero-crossing rate.

highlights.zh: 按原生预设的截止频率改回低通后：strings_lead 11×→2.2×、guitar_lead 5.8×→0.9×（略暗于原生）、bell_lead 的 −38 dB 电平也回来了。
highlights.en: Flipped to the lowpass their native presets use, at the native cutoffs: strings_lead 11x to 2.2x, guitar_lead 5.8x to 0.9x (slightly darker than native), and bell_lead's −38 dB level recovered.
